- Glowing markings unique to their mythology
- Ancient runes/faction-specific sacred symbols

- Reality distortion around the character
- Elemental effects matching their power domain
- Gate energy woven into their being
Each god needs a UNIQUE divine signature — do NOT use the same glowing effect on every character.

TITAN PHYSICAL DESIGN (FEMALE):
Feminine silhouette, athletic/curvaceous heroic proportions, elegant but powerful forms, divine beauty.
NOT generic anime, NOT generic bodybuilder. Target: Powerful + Divine + Beautiful + Legendary.

WEAPONS MUST HAVE LORE:
Design weapons using: Mythology + God + Realm + Faction + Combat Role + Divine Power.
The weapon should feel like a legendary artifact, not generic RPG equipment.

DIVINE POWERS MUST REFLECT LORE:

3D CHARACTER STANDARD:

Stylized but detailed — NOT photorealistic. Premium dark mythological tactical RPG aesthetic.
